title: Ectopic beats and HRV
question: Per successive pair of RR intervals in the first 15 minutes of each record: is the mean |ΔRR| larger in MIT-BIH 119 than in NSR 16265, computed from every beat (abs_d_all) and from NN intervals only (abs_d_nn)?

issues.text: Three records are three people: a difference between records is a difference between people as much as between rhythms.
issues.fix: Read the test within each record (every beat against NN), and widen to all 48 MIT-BIH records for a between-rhythm claim.

issues.text: The NN filter removes intervals around ectopic beats, but also gaps and artefacts: not all of the inflation is ectopy.
issues.fix: Count what the filter removed per record (ectopic beats, noise gaps over 2 s) in the hrv table.

issues.text: "Variability" can mean SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50 or spectral power.
issues.fix: The plan uses the absolute successive difference (RMSSD's ingredient).

alternatives.question: Is the median (coupling + pause) / 2·NN of 119's PVCs equal to 1 (a full compensatory pause)?
alternatives.why: Drills into the ectopic beats themselves.

alternatives.question: Does the Poincaré slope of RRₙ₊₁ on RRₙ stay near 1 in NN pairs of the healthy record?
Does NN RMSSD fall with age across the nsrdb and nsr2db subjects?
alternatives.why: Expands to more people and a real predictor.

hypotheses.statement: Computed from every beat, the absolute successive RR difference is larger in MIT-BIH 119 than in NSR 16265.
hypotheses.null: The mean |ΔRR| from every beat is the same in both records.

hypotheses.statement: From normal-to-normal intervals only, the absolute successive difference of 119 is within a few ms of 16265's.
hypotheses.null: The NN |ΔRR| of 119 is still several times 16265's.

hypotheses.statement: In NN pairs, each RR interval predicts the next (the Poincaré comet lies along the identity line).
hypotheses.null: RRₙ₊₁ does not depend on RRₙ.

concepts.label: Beat
concepts.description: One annotated heartbeat: its sample time t and label a (N, A, V, ...).
concepts.why: The unit RR intervals are made of.

concepts.label: RR interval
concepts.why: Everything in HRV is built from it.

concepts.label: Normal-to-normal interval
concepts.description: An RR interval with a normal beat at both ends, 300–2000 ms.
categories: touches an ectopic beat or gap

concepts.label: Successive RR difference
concepts.description: |RRₙ − RRₙ₋₁|: from every beat (abs_d_all) or NN only (abs_d_nn).

concepts.label: Record
concepts.description: One person's Holter recording (nsrdb 16265, mitdb 100, mitdb 119).

concepts.label: Subject age
concepts.description: Age of the person recorded (in the record header notes).
concepts.why: HRV falls with age: a confounder between records.

strategy.detail: LightWAVE action=info gives the header note (e.g. " 32 M") per record.

data.request: Age and sex from each record's header notes, for all nsrdb and mitdb records
data.why: To compare HRV between people at all, age must be held constant.

method.summary: Welch-type posterior of the difference in mean |ΔRR| between mitdb 119 and nsrdb 16265, once for every-beat differences and once for NN only.

steps.title: Beat annotations
steps.detail: LightWAVE fetch annotator=atr for nsrdb 16265 (t0 0, dt 900) and mitdb 100, 119 (dt 0: the whole record), cut to the first 900 s.

steps.title: RR intervals
steps.detail: rr_ms = Δt · 1000 / fs between successive beat labels; rhythm, noise and artefact marks dropped.

steps.title: NN or not
steps.detail: nn = prev == N and a == N and 300 < rr_ms < 2000.

steps.title: Compare |ΔRR|
steps.detail: means of abs_d_all and abs_d_nn, mitdb 119 against nsrdb 16265; hrv table for RMSSD = √mean(ΔRR²).

steps.title: Is the excess ectopic?
steps.detail: Accept H1 and H2 together: the NN filter removes the difference.

caveats: Three people, not three rhythms: age, sex, medication and activity differ.
15-minute windows; SDNN depends on window length.
Successive differences are serially correlated, so the means test is optimistic about its interval.
Annotations are cardiologists' labels; a device's beat detector would make its own errors.
